title: React Today and Tomorrow and  90% Cleaner React With Hooks
summary: The first three talks from React Conf 2018, by Sophie Alpert, Dan Abramov and Ryan Florence. They introduce React Hooks and explain the problems with classes that hooks solve.
why: It is the canonical introduction to hooks, given by the people who built them, and HN uses it to answer questions about why hooks exist.

quote.text: It's absolutely worth the watch, even if you're somewhat familiar with hooks.
